nukes.name: Arak
nukes.info: Heavy-water reactor at Khondab struck Apr 3 (Wikipedia/IDF confirmed). Plutonium pathway facility — alternate route to weapons-grade. IAEA monitoring. Reactor not yet operational at full capacity.

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Built into mountain near Qom. Designed to survive bunker busters. US claimed earlier strikes 'obliterated' enrichment, but IAEA cannot verify. nukes.name: Yazd (Ardakan)
nukes.info: Yellowcake plant struck Apr 3 (IDF/Wikipedia). Yellowcake is early-stage uranium processing — feeds enrichment pipeline. Damage limits Iran's ability to produce new feedstock for years.

nukes.name: Parchin
nukes.info: Nuclear weapon component testing facility near Tehran. Confirmed damage. Historical site of suspected weaponization research. IAEA had been denied access here for years.

nukes.name: Dimona (Israel)
nukes.info: Iranian missiles hit Arad + Dimona near Israel's Negev nuclear center. 100+ injured. IAEA: no damage to nuclear facility. First time area was targeted this war. Israel does not officially confirm Dimona's role.

assessment.body:
TWO STORIES TODAY — completely contradictory.

STORY 1: HISTORIC INDIAN MARKET RALLY
• Sensex CLOSED +2,988 (+3.85%) at 77,605 — biggest single-day gain in years
• Nifty CLOSED +890 (+3.85%) at 24,014 — crossed 24,000 mark
• ₹16 LAKH CRORE wealth created in single session
• Brent crashed 13.24% to $94.80
• WTI -13.76% to $97.41
• IndiGo +9-10% (top Nifty gainer), L&T +7%, Bajaj Finance +5%, Adani Ports +6%, Realty index +5%
• RBI held repo at 5.25%, neutral stance, CPI FY27 projection 4.6%
• Borrowers save up to ₹13.9 lakh on home loans
• India = the quiet winner of the war

STORY 2: CEASEFIRE BEING VIOLATED — REGION STILL UNDER FIRE
Within HOURS of Trump's announcement, hostilities continued across the Gulf:

• ISRAEL: Israeli military identified Iranian ballistic missile launches MINUTES after ceasefire. Cluster munitions over Tel Aviv ~3 AM. Photo evidence (Getty/AP).
• UAE: Air defenses 'actively engaging' Iranian missiles + drones. Defense Ministry confirmed 'sounds heard in scattered areas of the country are the result of UAE air defense systems intercepting ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, and drones.'
• KUWAIT: Shot down 28 Iranian drones. Three power and water desalination plants 'severely damaged.'
• BAHRAIN: Sitra Island hit. 2 citizens injured by shrapnel from interception. Houses damaged. Fire at energy facility (controlled). Explosions in Manama.
• SAUDI ARABIA + QATAR: Civil Defense issued early warnings, activated defenses across the country including Riyadh.
• LAVAN ISLAND (Iran): Oil refinery attacked. Attacker unclear. Iranian state TV: firefighters working to contain blaze.

LEBANON — ISRAEL HIT HARDEST OF WAR
• IDF: 'largest wave of strikes' on Hezbollah since fighting started
• 100 sites in 10 minutes — Beirut, Beqaa Valley, south Lebanon
• Targeted: Hezbollah command centers, intelligence HQ, rocket/naval units, elite Radwan Force, aerial unit
• Lebanon NOT covered by ceasefire (Netanyahu confirmed, contradicting Pakistan PM)
• Israeli airstrike on vehicle in Saida
• Smoke rising from Tyre
• 1,530+ Lebanese killed since March 2 incl 130 children

NUCLEAR RISK CANNOT BE RULED OUT
The biggest unresolved threat remains Iran's stockpile of highly enriched uranium:

• IAEA estimates: ~440-460kg of 60% enriched uranium
• Enough for 9-11 nuclear weapons IF further enriched to 90% weapons-grade
• Stockpile believed deeply buried at Isfahan + Natanz tunnel complexes
• IAEA Grossi (Mar 9): part of stockpile now in 2 locations
• IAEA has had NO access since Operation Midnight Hammer
• Breakout time: 'days to weeks' (FactCheck.org, multiple experts)
• Trump on Truth Social Apr 8: 'There will be no enrichment of uranium' + US will 'dig up and remove all of the deeply buried Nuclear Dust'
• Iran's 10-point plan DEMANDS 'right to enrich' — direct contradiction unresolved
• Iran AEOI head Mohammad Eslami called Bushehr strikes 'blatant war crime' in letter to IAEA
• CSIS: extraction operation would be 'most complicated special operation in history'
• Iran SNSC: 'ceasefire does not signify termination of war' + 'our hands are on the trigger'
• Pro-government demonstrators in Tehran chanted 'Death to America, death to Israel' DURING ceasefire announcement

GULF AIR DEFENSE STOCKS DEPLETED
By late March: UAE + Kuwait spent ~75% of Patriot interceptor stocks. Bahrain depleted ~87% (JINSA). UAE total interceptions since war: 520 ballistic missiles + 2,221 drones + 26 cruise missiles. ACLED data: US/Israel launched 3,000+ strikes on Iran since Feb 28; Iran retaliated with 1,511 strikes. Iran ambassador to Pakistan warned Gulf states: 'pay attention to conditions and relations with Iran.'

INDIA = THE QUIETEST WINNER
• 8 of 9 LPG carriers extracted BEFORE ceasefire (Green Asha last)
• Reliance bought 2 MILLION barrels Iranian crude DIRECTLY (Apr 7)
• Sea Bird (Iranian LPG, 44k MT) at Mangalore — first Iranian LPG in 7 years
• Jaishankar-Araghchi diplomatic call validated
• 51 lakh LPG cylinders delivered Mon (95% online), ZERO dry-outs
• 60 days fuel stock buffer never breached
• India supplied fuel to Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, Maldives throughout
• 345 Indian fishermen returned from Iran
• Pakistan brokered with India as quiet diplomatic backer

WHAT VP VANCE SAID
The US Vice President called the truce 'fragile.' Gen Dan Caine (Joint Chiefs Chairman): US 'remains ready to continue combat operations if called upon.' Pentagon briefing held with War Secretary Hegseth. Israeli officials privately 'skeptical' the deal will hold.

WHAT TO WATCH NEXT 24 HOURS
1. Will Iranian strikes stop OR escalate?
2. Will Israeli operations in Lebanon expand?
3. First commercial ship through Hormuz under ceasefire
4. Friday April 10: Islamabad talks begin
5. Iran's HEU — extraction or negotiation?
6. Hezbollah response to largest strike yet

BOTTOM LINE
DAY 40 delivered the biggest Indian market gain in years AND the most contradictory situation of the war. Trump declared ceasefire, markets celebrated, Sensex +2,988, ₹16 lakh crore wealth created. BUT: Iran fired missiles at Israel/UAE/Kuwait/Bahrain within hours. Israel launched its largest Hezbollah strike of the war. Iran's 460kg of 60% HEU remains unaccounted with breakout time measured in days. The ceasefire is holding officially but being violated operationally. India enters this moment as the war's quietest winner — strategic foresight delivered, energy buffer intact, fleet extracted, markets rallying — but the underlying war is far from over. The nuclear risk has NOT been eliminated.
